dimensions.rationale: R241-IDENTITY, R241-REVIEW, R241-SCHEMAS, R241-CONSISTENCY and R241-PUBLICATION remain fully traced to acceptance, evidence, owners and final-audit gates. Revision 5 does not change product requirements.
Workstream writes, lead-owned plan/work roots, Release 2.4 read-only paths and forbidden writes are unchanged. The review-binding files stay under lead-owned plans/release-2-4-1.
Acceptance-to-evidence routing and validation commands are unchanged. Revision 5 only remints the executable review binding.
Fail-closed identity, pre-mutation reviewId validation, historical read-only evidence and no-threshold-reduction gates are unchanged.
dependsOn remains release-2-4. WS241-03 still owns the Release 2.5 predecessor binding. Historical artifacts stay readable.

planReview.report binds plans/release-2-4-1/plan-review-r5.json. planFiles is lexicographic with plan-review-r5.json before plan-review.md. The supplied canonical digest b69bb8f292db501dab5ad2ec78461d81059c56977499b03269d2ce22c89c0870 matches this reminted DRAFT. After this report is written, agent-plan-lock.v2 can be generated and adopt-plan can load the report path.

findings.message: Revision 4 inserted plan-review-r4.json after plan-review.md, so 2.4.0 lock generation rejected the inventory as unsorted. Revision 5 remints the report as plan-review-r5.json, places it before plan-review.md, and the full planFiles list is lexicographic. README records EXECUTABLE_REVIEW_BINDING_REMEDIATED and plan-review.md records the r4 sort finding. The supplied exact canonical digest matches this corrected manifest.
findings.requiredAction: Write this r5 agent-plan-review.v1 to plans/release-2-4-1/plan-review-r5.json, then generate agent-plan-lock.v2 for this audited revision only.

findings.message: Revision 3 lacked planReview.report and v2 locks carry no reviewPath, so adopt-plan failed before mutation. Revision 5 keeps the required report binding at plans/release-2-4-1/plan-review-r5.json with reviewedRevision 5.
findings.requiredAction: Keep planReview.report inside the frozen v2 inventory.

findings.message: The roadmap still displays the ignored tasks path for 2.4.1. WS241-03 already owns that publication surface.
findings.requiredAction: Update the roadmap to plans/release-2-4-1 during publication.

findings.message: Release 2.5 already names release-2-4-1. WS241-03 retains those writes as deterministic publication checks, not extra product scope.
The ignored tasks/ mirror remains a non-authoritative older copy. Freeze and adopt must use plans/release-2-4-1 only.
findings.requiredAction: Do not give the tasks mirror lock or freeze authority.

summary: Release 2.4.1 revision 5 is READY_TO_FREEZE. The bounded r5 delta remints planRevision and planReview.report to plan-review-r5.json, sorts planFiles lexicographically with that report before plan-review.md, and records the r4 unsorted-inventory finding. PLAN-FILES-UNSORTED-R4 is resolved against the checked inventory and digest b69bb8f292db501dab5ad2ec78461d81059c56977499b03269d2ce22c89c0870. Product scope is unchanged. No open Medium or High finding remains.
